title: Achieving theranostic probes targeting BRD3/BRD4 for imaging and therapy of tumor.
authors: Gao, Yuqi; Liu, Qiao; Song, Cong; Song, Shubin; Tian, Chengsen; Li, Jianjun; Liu, Wenjie; Cheng, Mingyu; Zhang, Sitao; Wang, Xu; Xia, Chengcai; Liu, Tingting
one_liner_zh: 该文开发靶向BRD3/BRD4的荧光探针用于肿瘤成像与治疗，虽涉及蛋白-小分子互作，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The BET family proteins play pleiotropic roles in the tumorigenesis and growth of various human malignancies that have aroused great interests as the cancer therapeutic targets. Therefore, it's significant to develop labeling toolkits for the dynamic monitoring of BET family proteins in living tumor cells and tissue slices. In particular, there are few small-molecule fluorescent probes based on BET family proteins developed for real-time imaging of these proteins in tumor cells and tissues and treatment of breast cancer. In general, antibodies of BET family proteins are chosen for imaging of these proteins. However, the cost of these antibodies is more expensive than small molecules and the operation is relatively complicated. Moreover, the antibodies for imaging are not capable of the therapy for breast cancer. Thus, it's essential to exploit a novel imaging system for BET family proteins which is easy-operating and economical, with achieving therapeutic effects simultaneously. Therefore, a series of fluorescent probes (17-21) targeting BET family proteins were developed. Through the evaluation studies, probe 17 showed advantages in docking studies, analysis of cell viability, and imaging studies. Importantly, probe 17 was capable of distinguishing tumor cells and tissue slices and made a distinction between them by labeling BRD3 and BRD4 proteins. Importantly, probe 17 showed higher resolution in mouse tumor and human tumor slice imaging than BRD3 and BRD4 antibodies. Moreover, compared with these antibodies, probe 17 was more stable, more economical and easier to operate in the imaging assays. In addition, it also played an anti-tumor role by inducing cell apoptosis, proliferation inhibition, and cycle arrest in tumor cells. All these features render probe 17 to perform as an effective labeling toolkit compatible for imaging studies of BRD3/BRD4, as well as an approach to diagnosis and treatment of breast cancer.
abstract_zh: BET家族蛋白在多种人类恶性肿瘤的发生和生长中发挥多效性作用，因此作为癌症治疗靶点引起了广泛关注。开发用于活肿瘤细胞和组织切片中BET家族蛋白动态监测的标记工具具有重要意义。然而，目前基于BET家族蛋白开发的小分子荧光探针用于肿瘤细胞和组织中这些蛋白的实时成像及乳腺癌治疗的研究较少。通常，BET家族蛋白的抗体被用于这些蛋白的成像，但这些抗体的成本高于小分子，且操作相对复杂。此外，用于成像的抗体不具备乳腺癌治疗能力。因此，开发一种操作简便、经济且能同时实现治疗效果的BET家族蛋白新型成像系统至关重要。为此，我们开发了一系列靶向BET家族蛋白的荧光探针（17-21）。通过评估研究，探针17在对接研究、细胞活力分析和成像研究中表现出优势。重要的是，探针17能够区分肿瘤细胞和组织切片，并通过标记BRD3和BRD4蛋白实现区分。此外，探针17在小鼠肿瘤和人肿瘤切片成像中显示出比BRD3和BRD4抗体更高的分辨率。与这些抗体相比，探针17在成像实验中更稳定、更经济且操作更简便。同时，它还通过诱导肿瘤细胞凋亡、抑制增殖和周期阻滞发挥抗肿瘤作用。这些特性使探针17能够作为BRD3/BRD4成像研究的有效标记工具，并成为乳腺癌诊断和治疗的一种方法。
